name: Brown Bear

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bear makes two attacks, using Bite or Claw in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

description: Brown bears are massive, territorial omnivores whose bulk and claws make them a serious threat to any traveler who wanders too close to a den.
